limitations: Linear or fixed-random-nonlinear probe accessibility is not information-theoretic loss; poor probes may miss nonlinear/rare information.
Extra dimensions/capacity/statistics/coordinate changes can affect probes even withsham controls.
Positive residual decodability may reflect readout calibration or objective mismatch; it does not proveencoderdefect or a trainable architecturalfix.
Meanpooling can discardorder; input_last seesonlyoneevent. Neither is a fullhistory oracle.
Noautomaticimplementation, GPUtraining, dataexpansion, seedsearch or oldcriterionrelaxation follows thisdiagnostic.
F addition may ease conditioning or nonlinear accessibility of already-encoded information; this is not proof of deletion.
Fused residual probe cannot separate quantity-head restrictions, training loss, and checkpoint selection causes.
